messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: latency anomaly + cross-region routing oscillation detected for policy 'affinity-latency-v2' affecting eu-west <-> us-west. Auto-mitigation: canary fallback to local variants applied. Severity: P2 — paging oncall(s). Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/affinity-latency

anya (sre-oncall): Oncall here, pulling logs. I see a client-facing 5xx spike starting ~09:10 UTC. Which customers are hit and what's the error profile?

mike (networking): We see RTT-based steering flipping every ~25-40s. Policy uses a 30s moving avg and looks to flip when samples are sparse. Traceroutes show repeated rehome -> same-POP bounce. Error spike is mostly 502/504 from edge proxies. Sample decision log:
```
# routing decision sample
policy: affinity-latency-v2
client: cust-413
measurements: {eu-west_ms: 82, us-west_ms: 78, window_ms: 30000}
decision: toggle -> us-west -> eu-west -> us-west
```

sara (infra): I disabled auto-steering for that policy: `redwoodctl routing disable auto-steer --policy affinity-latency-v2` — monitoring now. Also pinned cust-413 to eu-west temporarily: `redwoodctl routing pin --customer cust-413 --region eu-west --until 2026-03-15T10:00Z`

anya (sre-oncall): Confirming: after the pin, cust-413 error rate dropped to baseline within a minute. Thank you. Ellen, customer success?

ellen (cs): I DM'd the CS lead for cust-413. They reported degraded API latency and intermittent 502s from ~09:10-09:16 UTC. Asked for ETA; I relayed that we have a mitigation in place (pin) and are investigating root cause.

kevin (product): Note: affinity-latency-v2 was promoted from canary last week. Any recent config diffs vs v1? Could be missing hysteresis/hysteresis mismatch.

mike (networking): Found it — policy evaluator is truncating hysteresis_ms from config when it's delivered via the config API for certain builds. Means some instances had `hysteresis_ms: 0` even though intended default was 50. Repro: `curl -s GET /api/policies/affinity-latency-v2 | jq .config` returns "hysteresis_ms": 0 on one binary.

anya (sre-oncall): OK. Live mitigation plan: 1) keep auto-steering disabled for at least 1 hour, 2) keep affected customers pinned (done), 3) push hotfix to ensure hysteresis>=50ms or fallback to safe default, 4) increase telemetry sampling for low-volume POPs. Who will own the hotfix?

mike (networking): I'll own the hotfix. Plan: change evaluator to coerce hysteresis <= 10 -> set to 50 (defensive), unit tests + deploy to staging, then canary to eu-west for 10m. Deploy command I'll run: `deploy routing-evaluator --image=redwood/routing-eval:hotfix-4821`

sara (infra): For diagnostics I bumped the routing sample window to 60s and enabled extra telemetry on low-volume POPs. Also added temporary rate-limiting on control-plane evals to avoid thundering.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: incident-id: INC-20260315-1781234567. Status: mitigation in progress. Paging/suppression: auto-pager suppressed for related alerts. Postmortem owners assigned: @mike (networking) and @anya (sre).

anya (sre-oncall): Handing off to next oncall at 09:50 UTC. Current state: auto-steering disabled for policy, impacted customers pinned, hotfix built and queued for staging. Monitor: latency, 5xx rate, control-plane errors. Oncall-next: @sara please pick up.

sara (infra): Taking over. I will watch dashboards for 1 hour, keep pins in place, and verify hotfix canary. I'll escalate if we see residual flapping.

mike (networking): I'll open the PR to add config validation preventing hysteresis=0 plus unit tests and a small integration check that rejects policy promotion if hysteresis < 20ms. Also adding a doc blurb about sampling frequency and steering hysteresis.

ellan (cs): (ellen) Drafting customer-facing note: summary of cause (steering hysteresis misconfig -> route oscillation -> transient 5xx), actions taken (pinned routes, disabled auto-steer, hotfix ETA), and next steps (postmortem + remediation). Will share draft with @kevin.

anya (sre-oncall): Thanks all. I'll mark the incident as mitigated once hotfix promotes and we see 30m stable metrics. Closing checklist: follow-up postmortem, policy validation rule, telemetry improvements, customer comms. :thumbsup:
